title: NC Program — Syntax Error at Block
description: NC program execution halted at block N{val}. P082={val}. Syntax error detected: illegal G-code combination or out-of-range parameter.
probable_cause: Incorrect NC program modification, corrupted file transfer, or unsupported G-code for this CNC model.
diagnostic_steps: Review NC block P082 in program editor
Check G-code reference manual for supported codes
Run program in single-block test mode
remedy: Correct NC program. Re-verify with dry run before production restart.
required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.
escalation_path: If CNC-MJ-001 is not addressed (stop current operation. machine must be inspected before resuming production.), the fault will escalate in this order: CNC-SR-001, then CNC-MD-011. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
